title: The Summer Hikaru Died
description: Six months ago, Hikaru vanished for a week. Now, as his best friend Yoshiki senses something amiss and confronts him, the harrowing truth emerges.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Yoshiki confronts Hikaru about his suspicions and discovers the terrifying truth. Even though they try to live normally, eerie incidents begin to occur.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: While Yoshiki and Hikaru accompany their classmates to a creepy mountain trail, a mysterious man arrives at Kubitachi Village and begins investigating.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Recalling childhood memories with Hikaru, Yoshiki continues to struggle with his complex emotions. Desperate, he reaches out to Kurebayashi.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: As Yoshiki attends the summer festival with Hikaru, the village elders fret over the recent death and Tanaka ends up with more questions than answers.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: When Yoshiki's sister spots a creepy clump of hair in the bathroom, Hikaru visits the Tsujinaka home to investigate — but things take a deadly turn.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Yoshiki and his classmates discuss a story their teacher assigned them. Later, at a sleepover, Asako's sharp observations put her in grave danger.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: After the sobering realization that Hikaru is truly dangerous, Yoshiki decides that he must act and invites his best friend to skip school together.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Yoshiki and Hikaru investigate Nonuki-sama and its link to Kubitachi's history. While at the library, they get an important lead from a surprising source.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Kurebayashi shares her knowledge about impurities with the boys. Later, the elder Takeda loses his temper over Hikaru's ignorance of the Indo's history.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The boys' surprise encounter with Tanaka lands them in the hospital. When they return to school, Yoshiki pieces together the truth behind Nonuki-sama.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Though hesitant, Yoshiki asks his father about the Indo family's murky past and secret ritual. Later, Hikaru loses control at school and feels deeply shaken.

episodes_data.title: The Summer Hikaru Died Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: While everyone else attends the school assembly, Asako finds Hikaru wandering the halls. Alone at the beach, Hikaru reveals his final plans to Yoshiki.
